children: COTI plans to launch private cross-chain payments through its Interphase app in Q1 2027. The app will enable private transfers on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and TRON, with payments settled in under 60 seconds.
Interphase is COTI's flagship app, and the release is the first live phase of its core privacy product. The launch is also the main milestone on COTI's roadmap tied to the token.
The Privacy Layer for All Money

Interphase is the flagship app on the COTI protocol, and the first step in bringing private programmable money to everyday users. Its dedicated page is now live, setting out how it works and the roadmap ahead.

title: COTI: Interphase launches private cross-chain payments - Q1 2027
